text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-inference-prod p99 tail latency breached threshold (alertname=HighModelTailLatency)
ajay: acked in PD, I'm oncall. investigating CPU / KV cache metrics
maria: i'm seeing a spike in seq_len=1024 requests, looks like a small set of customers sending long contexts
ops-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-1729 assigned to ajay
ajay: autoscale bumped dedicated pool +2 replicas, ETA ~90s
lisa (monitoring): dashboard https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abcd shows p99 jump aligned with a deployment 3m ago
kevin (PM): any evidence of customer impact / 5xxs?
ajay: no 5xx, higher tail latencies only. preliminary: ~6 customers saw >200ms increase in 95th, not widespread
maria: mitigation helped but we're still getting repeated alert noise — the rule fires too fast on short bursts
ajay: propose quick change to rule to reduce noise while we root cause. current rule snippet:
```
alert: HighModelTailLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(model_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 0.8
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
```
ajay: suggested adjustments: increase `for` from `1m` -> `5m`, change severity to `ops` for the noisy model group, and add grouping by `model_variant`
lisa (monitoring): agree. also add `group_left()` by model_variant in the query or use `by (model_variant)` so noisy models don't cascade alerts for all models
maria: i'm going to create a temporary 2h silence for the alert while we push the rule change to staging and validate
ops-bot: Created silence silence/4f2c9a (matchers: alertname=HighModelTailLatency) duration=2h by maria
kevin (PM): please log impacted customers in the incident notes and we'll draft comms if status doesn't normalize
sarah-cs: standing by to reach out to the 6 customers if needed
ajay: handing off to night oncall @lisa — current status: p99 back to ~320ms after scale, under monitoring. I recorded all actions in the incident doc
lisa (monitoring): taking over. I'll run synthetic requests for the heavy models and validate new thresholds in staging at 06:00 PT
maria: follow-up action items (short):
- PR to alerts repo: set `for: 5m`, add `group_by: [model_variant]`, lower severity for low-volume models
- Add Grafana p99-by-model_variant panel to runtime dashboard
- Add automated smoke test to run after deploys for models with seq_len>=512
- Create maintenance window template for planned high-load experiments
ajay: noted. also suggest adding an annotation on Grafana for incident start/end for easier retrospective
ops-bot: Incident INC-1729 marked RESOLVED by ajay (duration 22m)
maria: I'll open the PR now and link it here. once merged, we lift the silence and validate with a synthetic run. will assign reviewers @lisa and @ajay
kevin (PM): thanks. Sarah will do customer outreach if any follow-ups are needed.
sarah-cs: contacting affected customers now; will report back any functional impact or follow-up asks
lisa (monitoring): synthetic runs scheduled, will confirm green before close of day
ajay: leaving a short runbook update: add note about seq_len spikes and recommended autoscale knobs
maria: great work team. quick retrospective tomorrow—but for now, PR link and grafana annotation will close the loop :white_check_mark:
